name: Lyrissa Yirath
source:
Bright and bubbly, Lyrissa is vibrant and full of life, both figuratively and literally as a competent life mage. 
Her free-spirited nature and determination to carve her own path may sometimes be perceived as stubborness and a rebellious streak, but there's no denying that Lyrissa shines with a bright light like a beacon in the dark that draws people to her. 

[From [url=https://wind-chimes-games.itch.io/reanimation-scheme]itch.io[/url]]
